items.title: Infancy Gospel of Thomas
items.description: The Infancy Gospel of Thomas is an apocryphal gospel about the childhood of Jesus. Together with the Gospel of James, it is one of the earliest and most influential sources detailing the activities and life of the young Jesus, although neither text is included in the New Testament canon. items.title: Jensen Huang
items.description: Jen-Hsun "Jensen" Huang is a Taiwanese and American electrical engineer and business executive who is the co-founder, president, and chief executive officer (CEO) of Nvidia, one of the world's most valuable companies. As of November 2026, Forbes estimates his net worth at US$143.4 billion, making him the 13th-wealthiest person in the world.
